# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Organization — Workspaces

> 19 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Beta — Organization under Workspaces. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Workspaces

- [Archive Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/archive.md): Archive Workspace
- [Create Service Account Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/service_accounts/add.md): Add a service account to a workspace with the given `workspace_role`.
- [Create Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/create.md): Create Workspace
- [Create Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/members/add.md): Create Workspace Member
- [Delete Service Account Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/service_accounts/remove.md): Tagged service account ID (`svac_...`) named in the delete request. Removal is idempotent; see the endpoint description for the implicit-membership no-op.
- [Delete Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/members/remove.md): Delete Workspace Member
- [Get Service Account Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/service_accounts/retrieve.md): Retrieve a service account's membership in a workspace.
- [Get Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/retrieve.md): Get Workspace
- [Get Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/members/retrieve.md): Get Workspace Member
- [List Service Account Workspace Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/service_accounts/list.md): List the service accounts that are members of a workspace.
- [List Workspace Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/members/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [List Workspace Rate Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/rate_limits/list.md): List rate-limit overrides configured for a workspace.
- [List Workspaces](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Members](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/members.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Rate Limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/rate_limits.md): List rate-limit overrides configured for a workspace.
- [Service Accounts](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/service_accounts.md): Tagged service account ID (`svac_...`) named in the delete request. Removal is idempotent; see the endpoint description for the implicit-membership no-op.
- [Update Service Account Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/service_accounts/update.md): Change a service account's role in a workspace.
- [Update Workspace](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/update.md): Update Workspace
- [Update Workspace Member](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/workspaces/members/update.md): Update Workspace Member
